tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zab lam nā ro chos drug gi lhan thabs sbas don kun gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ zab lam chos drug 'chad par byed pa la/ 'dir theg pa thams cad kyi don gyi bcud phyung zhing*/ mdo rgyud thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam mchog rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi 'jug ngogs sam gshegs shul/ rgyud kyi rgyal po du ma rnams su rdo rje'i tshig tu sbas pa/ khams drug ldan gyi skyes bu zhig tshe gcig lus gcig la mchog gi 'bras bu ster bar byed pa'i nye lam dang myur lam khyad par can/ phyag rgya chen po shin tu rnam par dag pa'i lam gyi rim pa 'di nyid ston pa la/ khrid kyi mtshan don 'chad par byed de/ gang 'khrid/ gang gis 'khrid/ lam gang la 'khrid/ sa gang du 'khrid/ ces pa na/ gang 'khrid na zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi skal ba dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob ma'i sems rgyud 'khrid/ gang gis 'khrid na/ rang gi bsgoms pas nyams su myong zhing*/ slob ma la phyin ci ma log par ston par nus pa'i rdo rje slob dpon de nyid kyis 'khrid/ lam gang du 'khrid na/ zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gam/ rdzogs rim rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi lam la 'khrid/ sa gang du 'khrid na/ 'og min nam/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sar 'khrid do// khrid kyi rim pa de la yang sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rnam pa gsum las/ sngon 'gro 'od zer stong ldan ltar drangs nas/ da ni dngos gzhi ston pa la/ rje btsun til+li pa'i zhal nas/ dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// zhes pas/ sems dngos po'i gnas lugs dang*/ lus dngos po'i gnas lugs gnyis so// de la dang por sems dngos po'i gnas lugs kyi bsgom bya don gyi ngo bo shes par bya ba'i phyir/ lta bas don gtan la dbab pa/

lus dngos po'i gnas lugs bsgom par bya ba'i gnad shes par bya ba'i phyir/ lus dngos po'i chos gtan la dbab pa/ de la sems dngos po'i gnas lugs 'chad par byed pa la/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ sems ni ye shes lnga rnams dang*// bde ba stong pa nyid dag dang*// mi rtog pa dang ting 'dzin gyi// sems kyi chos 'di gnas pa'o// zhes pas/ gzhi lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa la/ snang ba sems su shes pas dngos po la zhen pa spangs/ sems rang rig tu shes pas dkar dmar gyi 'dzin pa spangs/ rang rig bde bar shar bas sdug bsngal dang btang snyoms kyi zhen pa spangs/ bde ba spros bral du shes pas zhen pa'i 'dzin pa spangs te/ lta ba khas len dang bral ba'o// de nyid bsgom par byed pa la/ til+li pa'i chos bdun ltar/ mi bsam/ mi sems/ mi dpyad/ mi bsgom/ mi dgag mi sgrub/ sems ni rang so nyid la bzhag /ces bsgom par bya ste/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs su ston// gnyis pa skabs su babs pa/ lus dngos po'i gnas lugs la/ chos drug ka dpe las/ lus ni byang chub rnam lnga dang*// rtsa dang byang chub sems dang ni// mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gi// lus kyi chos 'di gnas pa yin// zhes pas/ lus 'di byang chub pa lnga'i gzhi'i gnas tshul la brten nas bskyed rim bsgom/ rdzogs rim rtsa dang rlung dang thig le phra mo'i rnal 'byor la brten nas bsgom dgos te/ dang por lus kyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyang 'bras gsum las/ sbyang gzhi glo bur gyi dri ma/ sbyong byed bskyed rim yongs grub de gsal 'debs/ sbyang 'bras bral ba'i 'bras bu ye shes kyi thugs mngon du byed pa'o// de byang chub pa'am/ rdo rje gsum mam/ skad cig ma bzhi'am/ ril 'dzin nam rjes gzhig la brten te bskyed rim bsgom mo// de yang kyai rdo rje las/ zla ba ye shes me long ldan// rta bdun po la mnyam nyid ldan// rang lha'i sa bon phyag mtshan ni// so sor rtog par brjod par bya// thams cad gcig gyur bya nan tan// rdzogs pa chos dbyings dag pas te// mkhas pas cho gar gsungs pa yi// rnam pa lnga po bsgom pa nyid// ces pas byang chub pa lnga sgom ste/

gzhi stong pa nyid las byang chub pa/ gdan nyi zla las byang chub pa/ gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa/ thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa las byang chub pa ste/ de la mnyam med sgam po pa'i bskyed rim sgom pa'i lha 'chad pa las/ phyi lus lta bu'i bskyed rim 'khor lo sdom pa/ nang snying lta bu'i bskyed rim kyai rdo rje/ gsang ba snying gi khrag rlangs lta bu'i bskyed rim rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ zhes pas/ don dam mchog gi gtum mo ngo 'phrod pa'i rtags su/ yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ jo mo lhan skyes 'di sgom par bshad/ de'i sgom tshul kun rdzob dang don dam du sems bskyed nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa'i sngags don sems ma bcos par 'jog pa gzhi stong pa nyid las byang chub pa/ de nas chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa kha gdengs che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtse mo phra ba thur du zug pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma a dang raṃ las nyi zla bam pho mo mnan pa gdan nyi zla las mngon par byang chub pa/ de'i steng du bam̐ smug nag sgom pa gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa/ bam̐ sgrub byas nas bam̐ gyi yi ge mthug po phral tsa na/ gri gug dgra s+t+wa/ thig le/ chos 'byung sogs 'byung ba thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ de las don gnyis kyi 'bras bu byas yongs su gyur pa las/ bskyed rim rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par bsgom pa sku yongs rdzogs las mngon par byang chub pa'o// de ltar bsgoms pa'i bskyed rim de yang*/ rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa ste rnam pa gsum las/ rnam pa gsal ba 'ja' tshon ltar gdos bcas med par sgom ste/ rje phag mo gru pas/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lha sku bsgom// dgos pa tha mal gyi zhen pa spong*// zhes so/ rnam dag dran pa/ rang bzhin rtags kyi rnam dag dran pa dang stong pa'i rnam dag dran pa gnyis las/

rtags kyi rnam dag dran pa la/ kyai rdo rje las/ spyi bo'i bdag nyid mi bskyod pa// mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen dag /lag pa rnam par snang mdzad brjod// ske rags dag la don yod nyid// yan lag rnams la rdo rje 'dzin// zhes pas/ lha'i rnam dag dran par bya ste/ rang nyid lhar gnas pa'i rna ltag tu phag zhal gyi ngur sgra sgrog pa chos sku 'gyur ba med pa mtshon/ dbu skra spyi bor bcings shing zar bu rgyab tu grol ba sems can bde la 'god pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod pa/ phyag g.yon bhan dha khrag bkang bsnams pa rtog med kyi zas la rol pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa yab he ru ka mtshon pa/ thod skam lngas dbu brgyan pa ye shes lnga mtshon pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba 'du byed lnga bcu rtsa gcig mtshon pa/ ma chags pa pad+ma'i gdan dang*/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa nyi zla'i gdan/ chos nyid rol ba bam pho mos mtshan pa/ nyon mongs pa sreg pa'i phyir du ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa rnams bsgoms pas/ rnam dag re re la sangs rgyas kyi bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan yod/ rnam dag ma bsgoms na shor khe dang nyes dmigs 'byung bas so// nga rgyal brtan pa ni dus dang spyod lam kun tu bskyed rdzogs dang ma bral ba bya dgos te/ kyai rdo rje las/ bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa'am// yang na he ru ka dpal brtson// gzhan pa'i sems kyi skad cig kyang*// dngos grub 'dod pas mi gnas so// zhes pas so// go don ni/ bskyed rim kun btags dang gzhan dbang dang yongs grub gsum las/ yongs grub ste/ bsgoms pas gsar du byung ba ma yin par go dgos te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu grags// rdo rje'i skye mched nyid dag ni// byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog

/sa ni spyan zhes bya bas te// chu yi khams ni mā ma ki// dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya ste// me dang rlung du rab tu grags// gzugs sgra la sogs sngags pa yi// de nyid du ni rtag tu nges// zhes pas so// de ltar bsgoms pa'i bskyed rim gyi lus bdag byin gyis brlob pa'i rim pa/ rang gi lte bar rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying khar rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo/ mgrin par rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ mgo bor skyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la tsaṇ+ḍi ka nag mo rnams 'god/ ngag byin gyis brlabs pa/ snying po ni/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ nye snying ni/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭ/ rnams bzlas/ de las skyo na 'od gsal la 'jug pa ni/ nyer bsdu bya ste rang gi snying kha'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros snod bcud 'od du zhu jo mo la thim/ jo mo snying kha'i bam̐ la thim/ bam̐ khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da la thim/ nā da yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas/ rang gi sems la ngo lta byed/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa rgyag ro snyoms su 'jog pa'o// da ni rdzogs rim bsgom pa la/ dmigs pa'i rim pa chos drug gi khrid yig ltar bya ste/ chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ bcud bsdus dag byed stong ra'i gnad gsum dang*// drod myur gtum mo chos drug rim bzhin no// zhes pas/ ma dag lus kyi stong ra/ dag pa lha yi stong ra/ rtsa'i stong ra rnams sgom du 'jug de nas gtum mo bsgom pa la/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud las// lus la ye shes chen po gnas// rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs// dngos po kun la khyab pa po// lus gnas lus las ma skyes pa'o// zhes pa ste/ lhan skyes de lus la gnas kyang lus las ma skyes te/ lus zhig kyang rnam par shes pa gnas gzhan du 'pho ba'i phyir ro// de yang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de tshul ji ltar gnas na/

rdzogs rim dngos las/ dang po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de ngo bo ngos 'dzin pa/ de gnas pa'i rten rtsa bshad pa/ mngon du byed pa'i thabs gtum mo bshad pa dang gsum las/ dang por gnas tshul/ bde bas stong pa la rgyas gdab/ stong pas bde ba la rgyas gdab pa/ bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes de yi ge e waṃ gyi don te/ dngos po kun la khyab pa snod bcud thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am/ snod bcud thams cad lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de'i mdangs 'gag pa med pa'i rtsal du shar zhing*/ lhan skyes kyi ye shes de yang rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag cing*/ yod med la sogs pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral zhing*/ smra bsam shes brjod kyi yul las 'das pa ste/ mi rtog pa'i rang bzhin de bka' lung mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas/ de lta bu rtogs dgos so// des lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngo bo ngos bzung ba bstan zin to// lhan skyes de gnas pa'i rten rtsa bshad pa dang gcig 'gyu ba rlung bshad pa dang gnyis/ bkod pa byang chub kyi sems bshad pa dang gsum/ sdom pa 'khor lo bshad pa dang bzhi/ de mngon du 'gyur ba'i thabs gtum mo bshad pa dang lnga las/ gnas pa rtsa bshad pa la yang*/ zhus len gyi mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med pa'i rdo rje snying pos/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba/ kye bcom ldan 'das lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gnas pa'i rnal 'byor can gyi rdo rje'i lus la/ las byed pa'i rtsa'am/ rtsa'i gtso mo du lags/ zhes zhus pas/ lan bka' bstsal ba/ rtsa rnams ni sum cu rtsa gnyis te/ byang chub kyi sems sum cu rtsa gnyis 'bab pa bde ba chen po'i gnas su 'dzag pa'o// zhes te/ lte 'og sor bzhir dbu ma'i sner 'dzag pa'o// de ni kun 'dar ma rab grags// zhes so// rgyas par bshad pa la/ rtsa'i gtso mo gsum gyi ming bshad pa dang gcig

rtsa'i rang bzhin bshad pa dang gnyis/ rtsa'i byed las bshad pa dang gsum/ rtsa'i rnam grangs bshad pa dang bzhi/ rtsa'i rnam dag bshad pa dang lnga yod pa las/ dang po rtsa rnam pa gsum ni gtso mo ste/ rkyang ma dang*/ ro ma dang*/ kun 'dar ma zhes bshad pa yin la/ rgyud gzhan du ni/ ser skya dang*/ lug dang*/ kun 'dar ma/ sgra gcan gyi rtsa sogs bshad pa yin no// de rnams kyi rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi nang nas/ byed las gtso bo'am bdag por gyur pas na gtso mo zhes brjod do// de yang g.yon rkyang ma shes rab nyi ma'i rang bzhin/ g.yas ro ma thabs zla ba'i rang bzhin du gnas pa yin la/ kun 'dar ma ni dbus su gnas pa ste/ gzung 'dzin gnyis spangs so// dbu ma'i mar snar byang sems dkar cha 'bab cing gsang ba'i bar du gnas pa yin la/ bud med kyi bha ga'i bar du gnas shing 'bab pa'o// yar sna ni spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga'am/ khro bo rnams kyi spyan dbus mar zug pa'o// byed las ni rkyang mas mi bskyod pa 'bab pa/ ro mas ni khrag 'bab pa/ shes rab zla ba'i rang bzhin 'bab pas so// de ltar rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis la 'dod lugs mang du yod kyang*/ rin chen rgyan 'dra ma'i lugs la/ dbu ma la dkris pa'i rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis su 'dod/ mnga' bdag mar pas/ dbu ma las gyes pa'i tshul du 'dod/ pha rgyud ltar rtsa gtso bor ston pas/ gnas tshul ltar mi bsgoms// bsgom tshul ltar mi gnas/ thags rgyangs pa'i tshul dang*/ gru gu 'khrugs pa'i tshul ltar gnas pa sogs bshad do// de yang 'khor lo bzhi la las byed pa'i rtsa brgyad brgyad gnas pa yin te/ de yang lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i nang 'khor du byang sems 'phel ba'i rtsa brgyad/ de bzhin du snying kha/ mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su sum cu rtsa gnyis te/ sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ming bshad pa la/ mi phyed ma dang*/ phra gzugs ma dang*/ rtse ba ma dang*/ g.yon pa ma dang*/ thung ngu ma dang*/

rus sbal skyes ma dang*/ sgom pa ma dang*/ dbang ma dang*/ skyon ma dang*/ 'byug ma dang*/ ma mo dang*/ mtshan mo dang*/ bsil sbyin ma dang*/ tsha ba ma dang*/ grub ma dang*/ 'tshe ma dang*/ de bzhin du yid bzang ma dang*/ sum skor ma dang*/ 'dod ma dang*/ khyim ma dang*/ gtum mo dang*/ rdul bral ma'o// de rnams kyis las byed de/ mi phyed spyi bo na gnas te/ klad pa dang zhag 'bab pa'i las byed pa nas bzung ste byed las so so/ de rnams las gyes pa'i rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis te/ rtsa'i gtso mo gsum yar bzhag sum skor phyin gyi snga phyir bzhag pa'i bar gyi rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi las/ khrag 'bab pa'i nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ khu ba 'bab pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ rlung rgyu ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ de rnams la bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod pa yin la/ de re re la stong phrag re re gyes pas rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis byung bas so// de las kyang phar dbye na rtsa phyed dang bcas pa'i bye ba phrag bzhi dang grangs las 'das pa'o// tshur bsdus pas stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi/ rtsa ba dbu mar 'dus pas so// des rtsa'i rnam grangs bshad pa bstan zin to// da ni rtsa'i rnam dag bshad pa la/ zhus pa dang lan gnyis las/ rdo rje snying pos rtsa 'di rnams kyi rnam par dag pa gang lags zhus pas/ zhal nas/ 'dod pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i sred pa dang*/ gzugs kyi sred pa dang*/ gzugs med pa'i sred pa gsum yongs su gyur pa'am/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sred pa yongs su gyur pa'am/ rtsa rnam pa gsum gyi sred pa yongs su gyur pa thams cad ni/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa ste/ gzung 'dzin gnyis spangs kyi rtsa dbu ma'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'o// de brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi nges pa'o// yang na thabs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin te/ dngos po sgyu ma lta bu'i mtshan nyid du brtag par bya ba yin no// des gnas pa rtsa bshad pa bstan zin to// 'gyu ba rlung bshad pa la/

rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang yan lag gi rlung lnga bshad pa ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ rlung zhes bya bas las kun byed// 'di ni rnam shes bzhon pa ste// lnga yi bdag nyid bcu'i ming can// rnam rtog 'khor ba sgrub byed rlung*// zhes rtsa ba'i rlung lnga la/ mnyam gnas kyi rlung lte bar gnas shing las byed/ srog 'dzin snying khar gnas shing las byed/ gyen rgyu mgrin par gnas shing las byed/ thur sel gsang bar gnas shing bshang gci 'dor ba la sogs pa'i las byed/ khyab byed tshigs la gnas pas g.yo 'dor la sogs pa'i las byed do// yan lag gi rlung ni/ rgyu ba dang gcig rab tu rgyu ba dang gnyis/ shin tu rgyu ba dang gsum/ rnam par rgyu ba dang bzhi/ kun tu rgyu ba dang lnga'o// las ci byed na/ rgyu ba mig la rgyu ste mthong ba'i las byed/ rab tu rgyu ba rna ba la rgyu ste tshor ba'i las byed/ shin tu rgyu ba sna la rgyu ste snom pa'i las byed/ rnam par rgyu ba lce la rgyu ste ro myong ba'i las byed/ kun tu rgyu ba lus la rgyu ste reg bya rtogs par byed pas so// 'di bcu'i byed pa bcings shing bsgrubs pas/ rlung dbu mar tshud nas bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum skye ste/ grub chen sha ba ri ba'i zhal nas/ dhū tir rlung bcu tshud 'gyur zhing*// rnam par rtog 'gags rtags 'byung ste// so sor dpyod pa'i yan lag go// zhes so// rlung gi ngo bo la/ ngo bo dang dus sbyor gnyis so// ngo bo ni/ 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin dbugs// 'byung ba lnga yi ngo bo nyid// gong bu'i gzugs kyi phyung nas ni// sna yi rtse mor rab tu brtag /rin chen kha dog rnam pa lnga// srog dang rtsol ba zhes byar brjod// ces pas/ srog thur sre ba'i dmigs pa byed/ dus sbyor la/ rtsa rgyud dgongs pa lung ston las// g.yas pa nas ni rgyu ba'i khams// rlung gi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te// ljang ser dag tu snang ba ni// las kyi mgon po rgyu ba'o// g.yon pa nas ni rgyu ba'i khams// me yi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te// kha dog dmar zhing ser ba nyid// pad+ma mgon po rgyu ba'o// gnyis ka nas ni rgyu ba'i khams// dbang chen gyi ni dkyil 'khor nyid// gser gyi kha dog lta bu ste// rin chen mgon po rgyu ba'o// dal zhing rgyu ba med pa'i khams// dag cing shel ltar gsal bas te// chu yi kha dog lta bu ste// mi bskyod mgon po rgyu ba'o// zhes so// gnas tshul ni/

skyes bu khams snyoms pa gcig gi lus la/ rlung nyi khri chig stong dang drug brgya rgyu ba ste/ rtsa rgyud dgongs pa lung ston las/ gos dkar la sogs bzlas bshad pa// brgya phrag gnyis dang nyi shu bzhi// bzhi po legs par sgres nas ni// sbyor bzhi bsdus te brgya phrag dgu// dgu brgya dag tu gang bstan pa// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i sbyor ba yi// de yi so sor 'byung ba las// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'o// zhes pas/ 'pho chen bcu gnyis zhag re la rgyu/ de la ye shes kyi rlung gi ngo skal re re la/ nga drug dang bzhi cha rgyu/ de la bcu gnyis pa rnams rtsis pas/ zhag gcig la rlung drug brgya dang bdun bcu rtsa lnga ye shes kyi rlung du rgyu'o// 'pho ba bcu gnyis kyi las rlung dag pas sa bcu gnyis thob/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis rdzogs/ bden gnyis mngon sum du rtogs te/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan// de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig /rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa/ rnam pa sangs rgyas kun rig mchog /ces pas/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob par bshad/ skyes bu tshe lo brgya pa gcig gi lo gsum dang phyogs gsum phud pas/ rtsa rlung thig le gsum ye shes kyi rtsa rlung thig ler 'gro ste/ tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// des 'gyu ba rlung bstan pa bshad zin nas/ bkod pa byang chub kyi sems thig le bshad pa la/ thig le'i ngo bo dang gcig nges tshig dang gnyis/ byed las dang gsum/ thob bya'i 'bras bu dang bzhi'o// ngo bo ye shes lnga ldan du gnas te/ bde mchog las/ thig le gcig la 'gyur med lnga// zhes dang*/ gsang 'dus las/ snying khar mi shigs pa'i thig le rlung dbu mar zhugs nas/ thig le gsum la brten zhes so// nges tshig ni/ nyon mongs pa dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thig cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i yon tan thams cad thig pas so// byed las ni/

skyon bskyed pa dang yon tan bskyed pas te/ 'di 'khor lo bzhir ma bcings shing 'dzag pa'i bde ba la brten nas 'khor ba skyed pas te/ dus 'khor las/ 'di rten pad+ma'i dbus su shin tu phra ba yi// rnal ma dag de dri dang kha dog phun sum tshogs pa rnams// skyes bu mya ngan gyis gdungs dag gi 'bras bu zad par ma byed cig /ces dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ zag bcas bde ba tshwa sgo'i thang la phyin gyur kyang*// bde chen yan lag brgyad ldan mi rnyed skom pas gdungs// zhes so/ des na thig le ma bsrungs pas mngon shes la sogs pa 'grib pa drang srong rwa can lta bu'o// gzhan yang slob dpon 'phags pa'i rtsa ltung brgyad pa las/ chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems// de spong pa ni lnga pa yin// zhes so/ yon tan bskyed pa'i byed las ni/ 'di 'dzag med du bcings pas sa bcu lam lnga bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis 'thob ste/ mtshan brjod las/ bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can// yan lag med pa'i rtsis las 'das// bsam gtan bzhi yi rtse mo 'chang*// zhes pa bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang mchog dang thun mong gi mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul grub pa chen po brgyad 'thob ste/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las/ dkar po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po ri bong 'dzin pa las 'dzag 'jig rten spyi bor yang dag gnas// bdud rtsis 'chi ba bslu zhing srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed pa'i thig le'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// 'thob bya'i 'bras bu ni/ mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs pa'i sku 'byung ste/ kyai rdo rje las/ btsun mo'i bha ga bde chen du// ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cu ldan// khu ba zhes bya'i rnam par gnas// de med pas na bde ba med// bde ba med cing de med pas// lha yi bde ba las bde ba'o// zhes dang*/ rab mchog rgyal ba'i bdag po dag ni mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// dpe byad brgyad bcu'i bdag nyid ni// sngags pa dag gis bsgom par bya// zhes dang yang*/

kyai rdor brtag pa 'og ma nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i dbang bskur ba// ji ltar shes pa'i bde chen po// de yi 'di ni byin rlabs yin// gzhan las dkyil 'khor 'byung ba min// bde ba nag cing bde ba ser// bde ba dmar po bde ba dkar// bde ba ljang khu bde ba sngo// bde ba thabs dang bde ba shes// bde ba rgyu dang mi rgyu bde// bde ba dngos med la sogs pa// de bzhin kun tu rgyu skyes bde// rdo rje sems dpa' bde bar brjod// ces so/ gzhan yang yon tan thob pa'i gtam rgyud ni/ byang chub sems dga' byed dang*/ bla ma zhu yas dang*/ dge slong bstan pa'i blo gros lta bu'o// rnam par bshad pa las/ rdo rje'i lus la rtsas gar khyab tu rlung gis khyab/ rlung gi gar khyab tu thig les khyab ste/ thig le la nang gi skye ba bdun pa brjod de/ dang por bad kan dang*/ de nas mkhris pa dang*/ yang rlung dang*/ khrag dang*/ sha tshil dang*/ rkang mar te bdun du 'grim nas thig ler 'gyur bas so// de lta bu'i thig le de yang grangs su phye na lngar 'gyur te/ 'phel 'grib byed pa'i thig le/ skyon bskyed pa'i thig le/ yon tan bskyed pa'i thig le/ 'chi ba'i thig le/ srog 'dzin pa'i thig le dang lnga/ 'phel 'grib byed pa la dus 'khor sogs nas bshad pa mang yang*/ zla ba yar ngo dang mar ngo gnyis la 'phel 'grib byed/ phyi don zla ba'i dkar phyogs dang nag phyogs so// skyon bskyed pa'i thig le ni/ 'dod chags kyi skyon dang nyon mongs pas 'bras bu yid du mi 'ong ba sna tshogs myong bas so// yon tan bskyed pa ni/ tshul khrims bsrungs pas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan rnams 'byung ngo*// 'pho ba'i thig le ni/ dkar cha ham̐ nas mar 'phyug dmar cha a nas yar 'phyug pas/ rmi lam du spre'u dkar po sna dmar bzhon nas kha shar du 'gro ba rmis na 'chi bas/ tshe sgrub ga'u ma sogs brten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/

yang srog 'dzin pa'i thig le ni/ 'khor lo bzhi'i dbus su thig le'i dwangs ma snum la 'dril ba/ bya ko ka li ka'i mgrin pa ltar 'tsher ba sngo ba che chung sran ma tsam re gnas so// des srog 'dzin cing brtan par byed pa ste/ bzhi tshan de rnams kyi 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa'i nyams len dang gnas lugs bstan pa'o// des bkod pa byang chub kyi sems bshad pa bstan nas/ sdom pa 'khor lo bshad pa la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dkon mchog gsum sdom pa ste/ lte bar sprul sku/ snying khar chos sku/ mgrin par longs sku/ spyi bor ngo bo nyid sku sdom pas 'grub/ chos dkon mchog la bden pa bzhi ste/ lte bar sdug bsngal bden pa/ snying khar kun 'byung bden pa/ mgrin par 'gog pa'i bden pa/ spyi bor lam gyi bden pa 'grub/ dge 'dun dkon mchog la/ lte bar gnas brtan pa'i sde pa/ snying khar yod smra'i sde pa/ mgrin par mang pos bkur ba'i sde pa/ spyi bor phal chen pa'i sde pa'o// de bzhin du skad cig bzhi/ dga' ba bzhi/ dbang bzhi/ sku bzhi sogs gong bzhin no// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de sdom par bshad pa la/ rgyas par bshad pa ni/ phyi ru bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba rnams sdom pa yin la/ nang du rtsa 'khor lo bzhir dwangs ma byang chub kyi sems 'gyur med du sdom pa'i dbye ba yang bshad par bya ste/ de la yang*/ gang sdom par bya ba'i yul dang*/ gang du sdom par byed pa'i gnas dang*/ thabs gang gis sdom par bya ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sam dwangs ma sdom pas te/ de yang ba bzhon gyi lus la 'o mas khyab par gnas kyang*/ nu sor nas ma 'then na 'o ma mi 'byung ba de bzhin du/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes des lus la khyab kyang*/ dus bzhi la gnas tshul bzhi ste/ sems kyi rgyal po de tha mal dus na lte bar gnas pas gtum mo/

gnyid kyi dus su snying kar gnas pas 'od gsal/ rmi lam gyi dus su mgrin par gnas pas rmi lam/ sad pa'i dus na spyi bor gnas pas sgyu lus bsgom pa sogs/ 'khor lo bzhir bcas rang bzhin gyi sdom pa bsrung ba sogs kyi las bsgrubs pas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug 'grub/ des sdom pa 'khor lo bshad nas de mngon du 'gyur ba'i thabs gtum mo bshad pa la/ dang po gtum mo'i don ci lta bu zhe na/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang rig pa'i sems nyid de/ yi ge e waṃ gyi don du gnas shing 'khor 'das thams cad la ma khyab pa med pa dngos po thams cad kyi mi stong pa med pa ste/ de yang lha'i dbang pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ thog mar 'di skad ces gsungs pa// de ni go rim ji bzhin du// lha yi dbang pos nyan par gyis// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gi ni grangs snyed kyi// kun gyi gzhi dang rtsa ba ni// yi ge gnyis su de bzhin bstan// yi ge e ni mar gyur la// yi ge waṃ ni pha zhes grags// thig le'i sbyor ba de bzhin de// sbyor de shin tu rmad byung ngo*// e ni pad+ma zhes bshad la// waṃ ni rdo rje nyid yin no// thig le zhes bya sa bon te// de las 'gro ba gsum po skyes// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ e ni shes rab nyid yin la// waṃ ni rab dga'i bdag po ste// thig le mi shigs de nyid do// de las yi ge nyid kyang skyes// chos kyi phyag rgya yi ge gnyis// de gnyis shes pa gang gis shes// des ni sems can thams cad la// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor byed 'gyur// 'gro ba gang gis yi ge gnyis// mi shes rtag tu 'don pa dag /phyi rol sbyor spang mthu ba bzhin// e waṃ yi ge sgyu ma la// thams cad mkhyen pa 'dir brjod de// dam chos ston pa'i thog mar ni// e waṃ de phyir brjod par bya// de la brgya byin lha yi bdag

/gal te rtag pa'i gnas 'don na// yig gnyis sgyu ma 'dren byed cing*// dam pa'i chos la bla mar bgyis// zhes pas so// de nyid gang du gnas na/ kyai rdo rje las/ btsun mo'i bha ga bde chen du// e yi rnam pa'i sdom pa gnas// sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /bde ba can na rab tu bzhugs// 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*// 'khor gyi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa nga*// lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin nga*// mchog mtha'i dga' bral dang por ni// mun pa la ni mar me bzhin// de bzhin bus kyang yid ches mdzod// ces pas/ dbang bzhi pa'i don no// gzhan yang*/ kyai rdor rgyud las/ rnal 'byor ma lus dbus gnas su// e yi rnam par sdom pa gnas// ji ltar phyi rol ji bzhin nang*// sdom pa'i dbye ba rab tu bshad// sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni// e waṃ rnam par rab tu gnas// e waṃ rnam par bde chen po// dbang las rab tu shes par bya// zhes pas/ rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo 'di ma rtogs pa rtogs par byed pa/ rtogs pa brtan par byed dgos te/ tha mal dus su sems kyi rgyal po 'di lte bar gnas pas na gtum mo sgom dgos te/ chos drug rje'i tshig rkang las// gang zhig lhun grub brjod bral 'dus ma byas// kha sbyor bde chen longs sku gang 'dul shar// sku gsum don ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyi// theg chen skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos// dbang bzhis smin byed dad dang brtson 'grus ldan// mi rtag skyo shas nyes dmigs sngon 'gro ba'i// lam mchog 'di la gang gis 'bad gyur pa/ \/

zla drug lo'am tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'gyur// thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar/ 'od gsal gti mug rang sangs/ rmi lam nyin 'khrul rang dag sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol/ bar do longs spyod rdzogs sku/ 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas/ rang lus thabs ldan rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi// a ham̐ 'bar 'dzag skad cig dga' bzhis brgyan// shes rab kha kha mu kha'i snyoms 'jug gis// zag bcas zag med dga' bzhi rim bzhin no// bcud bsdud dag byed stong ra'i gnad gsum dang*// drod myur gtum mo chos drug rim bzhin no// ri bong dbab bzung ldog dgram rlung dang bsre// zag med ye shes chen pos brgyan par bya// gtum mo zas su za ba/ stan du 'ding pa/ srid pa'i dbang zhu ba/ rlung rtar zhon pa/ gegs rang grol lo// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang*/ chos drug rdo rje'i mgur las/ lus kyi gnas thabs sgom pa'i yul// sems kyi gnas lugs lta ba'i gdengs/ phyi ni sgyu ma lha yi sku// nang na rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi// steng na haṃ yig rnam pa can// 'og na a shad tsaṇ+ḍa lī// steng 'og rlung gi 'khor lo'i dbyibs// srog rtsol bum can nyams len gyis// bar na bde stong gsal ba'i nyams// ming yang gtum mo'i gdams pa zer// sems skye med du rtogs sam tsā ba// zhes pas/ stong ra gsum gyi rjes su rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan bya ste/ rngub dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang*// mda' ltar 'phen dang rnam pa bzhi// sbyor ba bzhi ldan ma shes na// yon tan skyon du 'gyur nyen yod// ces so// de la gnad bzhi shes dgos te/ rlung sgra med du rngub pa rngub pa'i gnad// lte 'og tu skyur ba dgang ba'i gnad// rtsa mig tu gdab pa gzhil ba'i gnad// phyi nang bsre ba gtong ba'i gnad do// rlung gi gnad bzhi ma shes na// yon tan skyon du 'gyur nyen gda'// zhes pas/ rlung sbyangs nas gtum mo sgom tshul dang*/ lus sbyong thog mar yan lag lnga sbyong*/

dngos gzhi nā ro drug skor dang gangs seng ma'i rtsa ba/ yan lag bogs 'don sum cu so bdun ma/ ras chung drug skor/ lus sbyong bcu gnyis ma sogs lag len ltar rgyas par bya'o// de ltar byas nas/ gtum mo ngos ma zin pa zin par byas/ zin pa brtan par byas nas/ phyi yul la sbar ba/ nang lus la sbar ba sogs drod kyi bogs 'don nas ras 'bud sogs grub nas/ bde ba'i bogs 'don pa ni/ rgyud rang nas/ lte bar gtum mo sbar ba yis// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs shing*// spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs pas// bsregs pas ri bong can ham̐ 'dzag /ces sogs dang*/ phag mo dpyal lugs las/ rlung gis bskyod pa'i 'og gi 'khor lo nas bzhengs glog gi zer ltar rab gsal cing*// rtsibs chen gsum po bsregs shing 'khor lo gsum po 'byed par byed pa gang yin pa// dngos dang dngos med rnam spyod dang bral phag mo yi ni khyod kyi snying la gnas gyur cig /ṣa sogs yi ges bskor ba'i sprul pa'i rtsibs chen nyid dbang la bzhugs shing*// 'bar ba'i me ltar rab 'bar bdud rtsi rab zag pad+ma'i skud pa ltar phra la// rig ma sangs rgyas tshogs rnams bsregs shing 'khor lo gsum po 'byed par byed pa gang yin pa// dngos dang dngos med rnam dpyod dang bral phag mo yi ni khyod kyi snying la gnas gyur cig /sogs sbyar bshad byed/ de'i rjes su mi rtog pas bogs 'don pa ni/ rje btsun til+li pa'i zhal nas/ de bzhin rgyu dang 'bras bu ni// mngon sum ston par byed pa la// gnad ni rnam pa bzhi yin te// dus dang lus dang yul dang ni// rlung gi gnad dang rnam pa bzhi// dang po bca' ba lus kyi gnad// bsam gtan yan lag lnga sbyor ba// rang bzhin med pa'i lha ru bsgom// de ni lus kyi gnad yin no// rtsa yi gnad ni 'di lta ste// 'khor lo bzhi po gnad bzhi ru// rnam pa tsam zhig wa le bsgom// rtsa gsum mtshan nyid ldan pa de// gsal bar bsgom zhing lam du bya// de ni rtsa yi gnad yin no// dmigs pa'i gnad ni 'di lta ste// lte 'og sor bzhi'i rtsa ba ru// shes rab a dmar mgo gyen bstan// spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo ru// tshang bug ham̐ dkar mgo thur bstan// de gnyis brtan zhing bsgoms pa las// a las me 'bar ham̐ la thug

/byang chub sems rgyun a la thim// de ltar bsgoms par gyur pa las// thig le 'phel zhing bde ba rgyas// bde ba'i ngo bo mi rtog pa// de gsum dbyer med lhan cig skyes// 'du 'bral med pa'i chos skur 'char// zhes pa rnams so// sems rang bzhin gyi rmongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyong ba 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa khrid yig ltar drangs nas/ lung rgyab la chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ 'od gsal 'char byed bla ma'i mos gus dang*// bde chen zag bcas zag med lta stangs kyis// bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin rang shar 'byung*// 'od gsal bzung sbyang bsre ba mthar thug go// zhes dang*/ chos drug rdo rje'i mgur las/ gnyid dang rmi lam bar shed na// rmi lam 'gal rkyen 'thug po'i gnyid// gti mug chos sku'i ngo bo nyid// brjod med 'od gsal stong pa'i nyams// rjes la nyams myong bde ba 'char// ming yang 'od gsal gyi gdams pa zer// sems skye med du rtogs sam lo tsā ba// zhes dang*/ rje phag mo gru pas/ 'od gsal zin pa'i go ba de// gnyid kyi dngos por gyur pas na// stong gsal nam mkha' mtha' dbus med// ting nge 'dzin du gyur pas so// 'on kyang de la sad rgyu yod// ces sogs sbyar bar bya'o// nying 'khrul gyi sgrib pa sbyong ba rmi lam la dmigs pa khrid yig ltar drangs nas/ rgyab chos lung la chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ gang gis bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs la// rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad la 'bral med bya// nying 'khrul rang dwangs sgyu ma lam rim gyi// yon tan nyin mtshan dus su rang shar 'byung*// rmi lam bzung ba/ sbyang ba/ sprul ba/ sgyur ba/ yul snang gtan la 'bebs pa/ rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid ston pa'o// de kho na nyid la/ rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ rmi lam dus kyi shes pa de// skyes pa rmis na pho 'drer bzung*// bud med rmis na mo 'drer bzung*// byol song rmis na klu ru bzung*// dga' ba rmis na sems dpangs mtho// mi dga' rmis na nyams mi dga'// lar 'dre sems kyi rtsa ba ma chod na// rnam rtog gi 'dre la zad dus med/

yin min gyi chos la go rtogs dgos/ gol sa med pa dbu ma'i lam// lam 'di la skyo sun ga la yod// ces dang*/ chos drug rdo rje'i mgur las// rmi lam dus kyi shes pa dang*// bar do'i shes par bsre dgos te// rmi lam bar do bsre 'pho'i gnad// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i ngo bo nyid// ming yang rmi lam gdams pa zer// rmi lam 'byongs sam lo tsā ba// zhes gsungs pa rnams la sbyar la bshad/ sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol gyi dmigs pa rnams khrid ltar drangs nas/ lung rgyab chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ sgyu lus bden med dbang po rab 'bring gsum// 'bral med mos gus rang lus cir snang kun// snang stong zhen bral lha sku lam 'khyer bya// rab bla ma dam pa grogs su bsten pa/ 'bring tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa/ tha ma mal gcig tu ting nge 'dzin skye ba'o// zhes dang*/ chos drug rdo rje'i mgur las/ dus rmi lam tsam gyi snang ba las// gnad mgrin par oṃ gyi sa bon can// phyi yi snang ba sgyu ma tsam// nang na nyams myong smrar mi btub// nyin mtshan snang ba sprul pa'i sku// ming yang sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag zer// zhen pa log gam lo tsā ba// zhes sogs sbyar la bshad/ ma bsgoms pa 'tshang rgya bar byed pa 'pho ba'i gdams ngag la/ chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ 'pho bya 'pho byed bral ba yang rab ste// dga' bzhi mos gus dmigs pa rtse gcig gi// gyen du 'phang zhing smon lam brgyan par bya// rab chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi 'pho ba/ 'bring zung 'jug yi dam gyi 'pho ba/ tha ma byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba/ 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba'o// dus gnad rdzas gnad ngag gnad rlung gnad la// sbyang zhing 'pho ba mchog yin no// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang chos drug rdo rje'i mgur las/ lus sgo brgyad 'khor ba'i skar khung can// sgo gcig phyag rgya chen po'i lam// sgo brgyad bkag nas sgo gcig dbye// sems kyi mda' la rlung gi gzhu// hig ka'i rgyud kyis rab bskul nas// byang sems ham̐ gi 'ben la sdig

/rnam par shes pa chos dbyings 'das// ming yang 'pho ba'i gdams pa zer// rlung dus su khegs sam lo tsā ba// zhes sogs sbyar la bshad/ bar do'i gdams pa la/ chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ bar do'i snang sogs 'od gsal lha skus sbyangs// gang 'dul sprul sku mtshams sbyor skyo shas gnad// sgrib gnyis rang dengs sku gsum lhun gyis grub// rab bar do dang po chos nyid rang shar/ 'bring rgyal ba longs sku/ tha ma spyi gnad 'chug med lam 'khyer ro// sa chu me rlung 'byung ba bzhi la sogs// thim 'gros rang bzhin brgyad cu shes par bya// zhes dang*/ chos drug rdo rje'i mgur las/ rang lus dus kyi tshad la phebs// gzhan lus tshad ldan yul gyi gnad// bar na yig 'bru rlung gi rta// rang lus khang stong bzhin du bor// gzhan lus sprul sku'i ngo bo nyid// ming yang grong 'jug gi gdams pa zer// rlung las su rung ngam lo tsā ba// zhes sogs dang*/ 'pho ba bar do'i dmigs pa rnams khrid ltar drangs nas/ lung rgyas par spro na/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ tshe ring ma rnams la bar do lung bstan nas bar do la rnam pa drug tu mdzad/ da res 'khor 'das kyi bar dor ru// gnas lugs ngo sprod phyag rgya che// gzhi lta ba gtan la dbab kyang 'tshal// rnam smin skye shi'i bar do ru// rig pa sems kyi rtsal sbyangs phyir// lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis la 'bad kyang 'tshal// ting 'dzin lam gyi bar do ru// gnyug ma'i ye shes ngos bzung phyir// snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag bsgom yang 'tshal// rmi lam gnyid kyi bar do ru// bag chags lam du bslong ba'i phyir// 'od gsal sgyu lus sbyang yang 'tshal// lugs 'byung 'chi kha'i bar do ru// thim gsum thabs su khyer nas kyang*// 'od gsal ma bu sprad kyang 'tshal// lugs ldog srid pa'i bar do ru// sku gsum mngon du gyur nas kyang*// zhing khams gsum du bgrod kyang 'tshal// gal te mngon du ma gyur na// skye gnas rgyud pa'i bar do ru// smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar nas// bsam bzhin skye ba blangs nas kyang*// lhag ma'i lam rnams bgrod kyang 'tshal// zhes dang*/

de nyid kyi 'grel pa rgyal ba yang dgon pas mdzad pa la/ 'phrang sgrol 'khor 'das sa mtshams dbye ba kun gzhi gnad kyi ngo sprod dpa' bo rgyal byed kyi dmag dpung*/ rnam smin skye shi'i bar do la/ 'phrang sgrol skye 'chi 'ching sgrol/ rim gnyis bde chen gyi gsang lam dpa' bo rgyal byed kyi dmag dpung dang gnyis/ ting nge 'dzin bsam gtan gyi bar do la/ 'phrang sgrol gnyug ma rang mal du bcug pas bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung ba dpa' bo rgyal byed kyi dmag dpung dang gsum/ bag chags rmi lam gyi bar do la/ 'phrang sgrol nying 'khrul rang dag ngo sprod gsum 'dres dpa' bo rgyal byed kyi dmag dpung dang bzhi/ lugs 'byung 'chi ba'i bar do la/ 'phrang sgrol thim gsum thabs su khyer nas/ 'od gsal ma bu sprad pa dpa' bo rgyal byed kyi dmag dpung dang lnga/ lugs ldog srid pa'i bar do la/ 'phrang sgrol sgyu lus gnas 'pho 'khrul med ngos 'dzin/ mngal sgo bde chen du bgrod pa dpa' bo rgyal byed kyi dmag dpung dang drug go// de re re la yang don gsum gsum mo// don gsum gang yin na/ skye ba lam du 'khyer ba bskyed rim rnam gsum/ 'chi ba lam du 'khyer ba la rdzogs rim rnam gsum/ bar do lam du 'khyer ba la ngo sprod rnam gsum/ gsum ga lam du 'khyer ba la zhing sbyong rnam gsum rnams bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o// gzhan yang rje btsun gyi sku gsum ngo sprod las/ sa mtshams lag len du bstan na/ lam 'chi ba'i srid pa dang 'gyu ba gnad gcod kyi 'phrang phyi nang 'byung ba'i skye mched rim gyis thim pa'i rjes su/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba mtha' dag las rnam par grol ba nam mkha' sprin med pa la nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i chos nyid spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba/ ngo bo stong pa nyid kyi gnas lugs ma bcos pa ji lta ba zhig dus der 'char bas/ de ka 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku yin te/

de yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos/ de ngo shes par byed pa la/ da lta bla ma dam pas ngo sprad pa'i gnas lugs lta ba'i don go ba dang*/ mtshon byed lam gyi 'od gsal sbyangs 'tshal/ lam srid pa bar do la/ sngon byung yid kyi gzugs can/ snang mun 'od kyi bar dor dbang po kun tshang thogs pa med cing*/ las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan pa'i lus shig yod pa de ka longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/ zung 'jug lha'i snang ba sgyu ma lta bur bzhengs nas/ bag chags snga ma'i lhag lus sbyangs pa yin pas/ de yin pa la yin pa shes par byas te/ da lta bskyed rim lha'i sku la dmigs pa gsal ba dang*/ mtshon byed lam gyi sgyu ma rmi lam sbyangs 'tshal/ lam srid pa tha ma pa la rig pa las kyi rlung gi rang dbang med par bskyod pa'i 'phrang*/ dri za mngal gyi skye gnas 'tshol ba'i dus der pho mo sbyor ba byed pa la chags sdang skye bas/ sngar gyi gdams ngag dran pa'i gnad kyi rang nyid bde stong gi nyams dang mi 'bral bar gnyen po'i rtsal mthar phyung ba/ las kyi snang ba mi 'char dgu 'char dus phyis bsams nas skye ba len pa de ka sna tshogs pa'i sku yin te/ de yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos te/ de ngo shes par byed pa la da lta grol lam gtum mo'i drod kyi ye shes bskyed pa dang*/ chags lam las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dbang gsum pa rdzogs pa'i don nyams su myong bas phrag dog mig ser sbyang 'tshal/ mdor hril gyis dril ba la/ 'bras bu sku gsum mngon du 'gyur lugs kyi dus dang sa mtshams de ltar bgyid 'tshal/ zhes sogs sbyar la bshad/ 'bras bu 'grub tshul ni/ gtum mo bsgoms pas lte bar sprul pa'i sku mngon du byed/ snying kar 'od gsal bsgoms pas chos kyi sku mngon du byed/ mgrin par rmi lam bsgoms pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du byed/ spyi bor sgyu lus bsgoms pas ngo bo nyid sku mngon du byed do// mchog sku bzhi rtags brgyad/

thun mong du grub pa chen po brgyad la sogs pa phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'o// gang zhig drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen gyi// mtha' drug tshul bzhi ston pa drug dang man ngag rnams// sbas don kun gsal lhan thabs gsal byed 'di// khams skyo bla ma sku mched bskul phyir du// rdo rje 'dzin pa mi bskyod rdo rjes gsang mtshan bkod// 'di yi dge bas sangs rgyas bstan pa dang*/ bye brag bka' brgyud bstan pa rgyas gyur cig //maṅgalaṃ/
